ransomware, actors spend one to two weeks mapping or enumerating the victim netw ork to identify 
data enclaves, including cloud st orage and netw ork backups [TA0007 ]. Zeppelin act ors can deploy 
Zeppelin ransomware as a .dll  or .exe  file or contained within a Power Shell loader . [1]

nine-digit hexadecimal number is appended to each encrypted file as a file extension, e.g., 
file.txt.txt.C59 -E0C-929 [T1486 ]. A note file with a ransom note  is left on compromised
